note: FNS 1063.2 describes QC audit methodology for reviewing earned income in the third effective month following a certification action. The Comparison I/II procedures, the $125 variance threshold (a QC error-determination threshold, distinct from the $125 change reporting threshold), and the 'error determinant month' concept are all QC reviewer procedures with no caseworker equivalent. The underlying SNAP policy concepts — prospective budgeting (OLG: 'Calculate the Monthly Prospective Amount'), income averaging for fluctuating income (OLG: 'Income Averaging', 'Anticipated Income'), the $125 earned income change reporting requirement (OLG: 'Change Reporting – Overview', 'Verifying Earned Income at Interim Report'), and processing income changes at interim reports — are all covered in the OLG. There is no gap in caseworker guidance; this section is purely about how QC auditors evaluate whether the EW's income figure was correct.
